links.comparator_used: Full expert review of all DL-based QT measurements (uniform manual review)
links.outcome: Expert effort for ECG QT labelling while maintaining QT accuracy
links.effect: Only 10% of the data were reviewed per trial, mostly high-uncertainty measurements, with high QT accuracy maintained; effort significantly reduced (no numeric accuracy values in abstract)
links.quote: We assess its effectiveness on 3 drug safety trials and show that it can significantly reduce effort required for ECG labelling-in our experiments only 10% of the data were reviewed per trial-while maintaining high levels of QT accuracy.
